sentences.text:
The petitioner- Alimuddin Ansari is in custody since 15.04.2023 in connection with Jamtara Cyber Crime P.S. Case No. 21 of 2023 for the offence registered under Sections 414, 419, 420, 467, 468,
471, 120B of the Indian Penal Code and Section 66(B), (C), (D) of Information Technology Act pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge 1st, Jamtara.

entities.text: Jamtara Cyber Crime P.S. Case No. 21 of 2023
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: As per the prosecution case, the petitioner was running CSP Centre and it is alleged that he in connivance with others, facilitated cyber frauds and transfer of the proceeds of crime obtained by cyber fraudsters.

On getting this information, the police conducted raid in which two mobile, four SIM cards, six ATM cards, six passbook and checkbook, one POS machine, one laptop and Rs.50,000/- cash were seized from the CSP shop.
It is submitted by the learned counsel on behalf of petitioner that there is no material to connect this petitioner in cybercrime committed against any person.
The seizure does not connect the petitioner to the cyber offence.
Learned Special P.P. opposed the prayer for bail.
It is submitted that suspicious e-wallets were found to be created by the SIM of the petitioner.
However, it is fairly conceded that during investigation, by use of mobile of this petitioner cyber frauds were committed.

Under the circumstances, the above named petitioner is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-(Twenty Five Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the Court below.
(Gautam Kumar Choudhary, J.) Anit Alimuddin Ansari vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... .... ... on 19 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189838227/
